environment.description: Same application code deployed behind a Lambda function URL with AuthType set to AWS_IAM. The function URL resource policy specifies Principal: '*' with Condition aws:PrincipalOrgID matching the organization ID (o-abc123def4). Callers without valid SigV4 signatures derived from IAM credentials within the organization receive HTTP 403 before the Lambda function is invoked. The Lambda execution role has no public-facing assume-role trust policy. Note: the function URL endpoint is publicly resolvable via DNS but the IAM auth gate operates at the Lambda service invoke-authorization layer, not at network level. Function configured with 128MB memory and 3-second timeout.
